questions.prompt: Why does POST /prompt answer 202 at once instead of waiting for the model's reply?
options: The prompt goes into the inbox, and all progress, including the answer, arrives on the WebSocket
questions.explanation: The POST only hands the prompt to the agent as a followup. The answer is just more events, which the socket already delivers.

questions.prompt: The page held events up to seq 14 when its socket closed. What should it receive after reconnecting with after=14?
options: Only events with seq greater than 14, then new ones as they come
The whole log again from seq 1
questions.explanation: The snapshot filters to events after the cursor, so the page fills the gap and then follows live.

questions.prompt: Why does the server listen on 127.0.0.1 only?
options: Anyone who can reach /prompt can make the agent run commands
questions.explanation: The gateway is a remote control for an agent that runs commands, so it should be reachable only from your own machine.
